player_prompt.intro:
I SimpleTak-ah Player {player_id} i ni.
Papar-ah, i lungte chu '{player_stone}' anga langin, i khingpui lungte chu '{opponent_stone}' anga lang.

I khelh tumah, lung awm lohna cell (a number-in a hming) thlan la, i lung chu a hmunah dah.
Entirnan, '[12]' chuan cell 12-ah i lung dah.

I tum ber chu, i lungte a inzawmkhawm, papar piah pahnih a inzawm (chung atanga tla, emaw, veilam atanga tir a ni).

invalid_move.invalid_move_format: Hnawhchhuah format diklo a ni e:
invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Cell number {cell_num} a chim lo. 0 leh {max_board_num} inkar ah a awm tur a ni.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Cell {cell_num} chu a awm tawh lo. A tello pakhat thlang rawh.

action.placement: Player {current_player_id} an symbol ({symbol}) cell {cell_num}-ah a pe.
